title: バランスのよい食生活
sourceLabel: 既存教材をTOEFL形式へ変換 · 元の問1–9に対応
verificationNote: 英文の設問と4択へ変換したReading演習です。元の翻訳・記述問題は元記事でも確認できます。

passages.text:
A balanced diet is better understood as a pattern than as a list of perfect foods. Different foods contribute different nutrients: vegetables and fruits provide a range of vitamins and minerals, grains and other carbohydrate-rich foods supply energy, and protein-rich foods provide materials the body uses to maintain its tissues. Variety matters because no single food performs every role.

Balance also depends on frequency and proportion. Eating a sweet snack occasionally does not by itself determine the quality of an entire diet. At the same time, foods that contain large amounts of added sugar, salt, or saturated fat should not automatically become the main part of every meal. A practical question is therefore not "Is this food always good or bad?" but "How often, how much, and what else am I eating?" This broader view encourages deliberate choices without demanding an unrealistic idea of perfection.

questions.prompt: The word 'maintain' in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to:

options.label: A
options.text: keep in a functioning condition

options.label: B
options.text: discover for the first time

options.label: C
options.text: replace immediately

options.label: D
options.text: measure precisely

questions.answer: 正解：A。maintain は「正常な状態に保つ」。Bは初めて発見する、Cは直ちに交換する、Dは精密に測定する意味で、組織を保つという文脈に合いません。

questions.prompt: The word 'occasionally' in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to:

options.label: A
options.text: at every meal

options.label: B
options.text: from time to time

options.label: C
options.text: only once in a lifetime

options.label: D
options.text: at a fixed time each day

questions.answer: 正解：B。occasionally は「ときどき」。Aは毎食、Cは生涯一度、Dは毎日の固定時刻で、いずれも頻度や規則性を過度に限定しています。

questions.prompt: What does 'This broader view' in paragraph 2 refer to?

options.label: A
options.text: Judging foods by how expensive they are

options.label: B
options.text: Choosing one perfect food for every meal

options.label: C
options.text: Considering frequency, quantity, and the rest of the diet

options.label: D
options.text: Avoiding every food that contains any sugar

questions.answer: 正解：C。直前の How often, how much, and what else ... を受けます。Aの価格は言及なし。Bは一品で判断する見方で本文と逆。Dも完全禁止という本文以上の断定です。

questions.prompt: Why does the author emphasize variety in a diet?

options.label: A
options.text: All foods provide exactly the same nutrients

options.label: B
options.text: Only vegetables provide energy

options.label: C
options.text: The most expensive foods perform every role

options.label: D
options.text: Different foods contribute different nutrients and functions

questions.answer: 正解：D。第1段落の Different foods contribute different nutrients と no single food performs every role が根拠。Aは逆。Bはgrainsなどの役割と違い、Cは価格にも万能食品にも根拠がありません。

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the meaning of 'no single food performs every role'?

options.label: A
options.text: One food alone cannot serve all the functions of a diet

options.label: B
options.text: Every food should be eaten at every meal

options.label: C
options.text: A food has no nutritional value unless it is perfect

options.label: D
options.text: Foods can be judged without considering other foods

questions.answer: 正解：A。no single food は「どの一品も〜ない」。Bは全食品を毎食食べるという主張ではありません。Cは価値を否定し過ぎ、Dは全体の組合せを見る本文と反対です。

questions.prompt: Which statement is best supported by the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: A single sweet snack makes an entire diet unhealthy

options.label: B
options.text: One food can satisfy every nutritional role

options.label: C
options.text: Quantity, frequency, and combinations matter when evaluating foods

options.label: D
options.text: People should completely ban foods they enjoy

questions.answer: 正解：C。How often, how much, and what else ... に一致。Aは一度の間食を全体の評価へ広げ過ぎ。Bは no single food と逆。Dは完全な禁止を本文が要求しているわけではありません。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best expresses the essential information about eating a sweet snack occasionally?

options.label: A
options.text: Every sweet snack improves the quality of the entire diet

options.label: B
options.text: An occasional sweet snack alone does not determine overall diet quality

options.label: C
options.text: Snacks can never affect the quality of a diet

options.label: D
options.text: The timing of a snack determines whether all other foods are healthy

questions.answer: 正解：B。not by itself が重要で「それだけでは全体は決まらない」。Aは改善の断定、Cは影響が全くないという断定、Dは時刻が全食品を決めるという主張で、どれも本文にありません。

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: A balanced diet requires avoiding all imperfect foods

options.label: B
options.text: The quality of a diet can be decided from one meal

options.label: C
options.text: Foods should be classified as always good or always bad

options.label: D
options.text: A diet should be considered as an overall pattern of variety, frequency, and proportion

questions.answer: 正解：D。両段落は一品の善悪より全体の型を見る立場です。Aは非現実的な完璧さを要求し、Bは一回に限定し、Cは本文が退ける二分法です。

questions.prompt: Which approach to planning study time best applies the principle developed in the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Balance different activities over time and consider their frequency and proportion

options.label: B
options.text: Judge all learning by a single perfect study day

options.label: C
options.text: Use only one activity because it must serve every learning purpose

options.label: D
options.text: Stop studying whenever the daily plan is not perfect

questions.answer: 正解：A。元の発展記述を、本文の原理を別場面へ適用する推論問題に変更しました。pattern・different roles・frequency・proportion からAが導けます。Bは一日だけで評価し、Cは一種類を万能視し、Dは完璧さを要求しており、いずれも本文の考えと逆です。
